name: Smith squat
cue: Feet ahead of the bar; sit down between your knees.
research: Smith machine squat, feet forward (science audit table B: the Smith squat with the feet ahead is the hack squat and leg press alternative). Bar on the upper back (high bar, resting on the trapezius: the skin sits 0.004 H under the bar at every phase), vertical rails 0.36 H out with the plates outboard, rails 0.115 H behind the mid-sole line (feet ~20 cm ahead of the bar). Stance: soles flat on a foot plate 0.092 H either side of the midline (hip width plus a little), toes out 10 deg, solved by foot IK to the floor sockets (plate alignment keeps the soles flat). Bottom (stretch): thighs below parallel, knee 122, hip 112, ankle 29 (inside the 35 deg weight-bearing cap), trunk 28 deg forward of vertical with the spine neutral (spinal flexion 8); top: standing with a soft knee (13), trunk 6. The pelvis path is authored per key (roots), the trunk lean follows so the trap point stays on the rail line; the bar height follows the trap point through the intermediate keys M1-M3. Hands grip the bar 0.26 H each side (~90 cm apart, solved by IK, elbows down and a little back, elbow ~112, humerus 20 deg elevated). Muscles: quads (three heads) and glutes.

targets.note: The hands hold the bar behind the neck with the elbows down; elbow and shoulder angles are the IK solution for a 90 cm grip and are only guarded loosely.

camera.note: Research view az 90 / el 10 (profile: depth, trunk lean and the bar over the mid-foot). Turned 15 deg toward the front (az 75 / el 10): the quads face forward and read as a band on the thigh, and the glutes still show in profile at the bottom. The near plate and rail cross the upper body, not the legs. The base is a foot plate under the feet and the rails stand on short feet, so the floor under the name stays clear.
